meta.name: GeoAgent Reliability Lab Task Registry
meta.tool_id_policy: Abstract capability IDs used only by this harness; they are not verified Geoapify tool names, endpoints, or response schemas.
notes: All places, coordinates, routes, matrices, and geometry values are invented fixtures for software testing.
No response in this repository was captured from Geoapify or any live map service.
The route matrix coverage is represented by R-002 and R-004, not by an unverified live API claim.

tasks.title: Forward geocode a named synthetic landmark
tasks.description: Resolve a named landmark to one synthetic place record and verify the top result's stable place ID and illustrative coordinates.
tasks.user_prompt: Geocode 'Harbor Light' in Synthetic Bay. Return the top place ID and its illustrative latitude and longitude.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Resolve the landmark name against the synthetic fixture world.

assumptions: Synthetic Bay and Harbor Light are fictional fixture labels, not real places.
The expected record comes from this repository's synthetic fixture, not from a live geocoder.
Top-1 behavior is assumed for this deterministic fixture case.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The expected answer is a frozen synthetic fixture; no live data refresh is attempted.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative test record authored for this repository; not a Geoapify response.

tasks.title: Reverse geocode a synthetic coordinate
tasks.description: Resolve a synthetic coordinate to a synthetic street address and verify the address and stable address ID.
tasks.user_prompt: Reverse geocode latitude 0.0100, longitude 0.0200 and report the formatted address and place ID.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Resolve the requested synthetic coordinate to an illustrative address.

assumptions: The coordinate and address are invented test data, not a real-world location claim.
The fixture store contains one unambiguous nearest address for this coordinate.
No live reverse-geocoding fallback is used.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The synthetic address is frozen; real address changes are outside this test.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative test record; the coordinate is not evidence of a real address.

tasks.title: Geocode then reverse geocode a synthetic library
tasks.description: Run a two-step tool chain: forward geocode a library, pass its synthetic coordinate to reverse geocoding, and verify both steps.
tasks.user_prompt: Find 'Cedar Library' in Synthetic Bay, then reverse geocode its coordinate. Report the resulting street address.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Resolve Cedar Library to a synthetic location.
Reverse geocode the location returned by the first step.

assumptions: The output of forward geocoding can be passed directly to reverse geocoding in the synthetic fixture world.
The library and address are fictional test records.
The chain is deterministic and has no retry or live fallback.

dynamic_data_handling.note: Both steps use one frozen fixture generation; the coordinate is not refreshed from a live service.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative chained response authored for this repository.

tasks.title: Search cafes near a synthetic landmark
tasks.description: Search a synthetic cafe category within 800 metres of Harbor Light and verify result count, nearest ID, and distance.
tasks.user_prompt: Find cafes within 800 metres of Harbor Light and return the nearest result with its distance in metres.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Search synthetic cafes near the fixture landmark and sort by distance.

assumptions: The synthetic search index contains exactly two cafes within the requested radius.
Distance sorting is ascending and uses the fixture's illustrative metre values.
Category matching is exact for this fixture.

dynamic_data_handling.note: No live POI inventory or opening-hours feed is queried.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative place-search results; not a live Geoapify response.

tasks.title: Find an open pharmacy near a synthetic clinic
tasks.description: Apply a synthetic opening-hours filter at a pinned timestamp and verify that exactly one pharmacy is reported open.
tasks.user_prompt: At 09:30 UTC on 2026-10-21, find an open pharmacy within 500 metres of the synthetic clinic and report its place ID.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Filter synthetic pharmacies by distance and the pinned opening-hours snapshot.

assumptions: The opening-hours snapshot is invented and valid only at the pinned synthetic timestamp.
The result count reflects the fixture's open-now filter.
No live timezone service or business-status service is called.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The time is part of the fixture contract; a different time is outside this task's oracle.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative opening-hours fixture; not verified business data.

tasks.title: Find a cafe then route from the library
tasks.description: Search for a nearby synthetic cafe, pass its location into route planning, and verify the selected cafe and synthetic route distance.
tasks.user_prompt: Find the nearest cafe to Cedar Library and plan a walking route from the library to that cafe. Report the cafe ID and route distance.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Find the nearest synthetic cafe to Cedar Library.
Plan a walking route from the library to the first cafe result.

assumptions: The nearest cafe is deterministic in the fixture index.
The fixture route begins at Cedar Library and ends at the selected cafe.
Walking duration and route geometry are illustrative, not live traffic estimates.

dynamic_data_handling.note: POI selection and route are frozen together; a live inventory or traffic change would invalidate this oracle.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative POI and route records authored for this harness.

tasks.title: Plan a walking route between two synthetic places
tasks.description: Plan a synthetic walking route and verify distance, duration, and the number of legs returned by the route tool.
tasks.user_prompt: Plan a walking route from Cedar Library to Harbor Light. Return the distance in metres, duration in seconds, and number of legs.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Plan a synthetic walking route between the fixture places.

assumptions: The fixture route is a deterministic synthetic path, not a real network route.
Distance and duration are illustrative values, not traffic predictions.
One leg is expected for a direct route without waypoints.

dynamic_data_handling.note: No live traffic, closures, or routing graph are used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative route response; not a Geoapify route result.

tasks.title: Build a synthetic 3 by 2 route distance matrix
tasks.description: Request a route distance matrix for three synthetic origins and two destinations, then verify matrix dimensions and selected distances and durations.
tasks.user_prompt: Build a driving distance matrix for three origins and two destinations. Report the full matrix dimensions and the distance and duration for origin 3 to destination 2.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Return the frozen 3-by-2 synthetic driving matrix.

assumptions: The matrix is synthetic and does not represent a real road network.
Rows follow the input origin order and columns follow the input destination order.
Values are illustrative and not live traffic estimates.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The matrix is frozen; live travel times would require a future, explicitly labelled live adapter.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative matrix; no Geoapify matrix API was called.

tasks.title: Plan a route with one synthetic waypoint
tasks.description: Plan a two-leg synthetic walking route through a market waypoint and verify the total metric, leg count, and final destination.
tasks.user_prompt: Plan a walking route from the station to the park gate via the market waypoint. Report total distance, duration, leg count, and the final destination ID.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Plan a synthetic walking route with one market waypoint.

assumptions: One waypoint creates two legs in the synthetic route.
The fixture uses the input waypoint order without re-optimization.
All names and metrics are fictional test values.

dynamic_data_handling.note: No live waypoint optimization or traffic data is used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative waypoint route; not a live routing response.

tasks.title: Matrix, route, and reverse geocode in one chain
tasks.description: Run a synthetic route matrix, plan the selected pair, reverse geocode the destination, and verify that the shared distance and address are consistent.
tasks.user_prompt: Use the matrix to find the library-to-market driving distance, plan that route, then reverse geocode the market destination. Report the distance and destination address.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Create a frozen 2-by-2 synthetic driving matrix.
Plan the library-to-market pair represented by matrix cell [1][0].
Resolve the market destination to a synthetic address.

assumptions: Matrix cell [1][0] corresponds to the library-to-market pair.
The synthetic matrix and the planned route share the same fabricated distance.
The address is fictional and only tests chain consistency.

dynamic_data_handling.note: Matrix, route, and address are frozen together; no live traffic or geocoder is used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative matrix, route, and address records; not live results.

tasks.title: Point-in-polygon on a synthetic zone
tasks.description: Test whether a synthetic point lies within a synthetic polygon and verify the relation label and boolean answer.
tasks.user_prompt: Test whether the synthetic point at x=20, y=30 lies within the Cedar Green polygon. Return the relation and boolean result.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Evaluate the synthetic point-in-polygon relation.

assumptions: The point and polygon are synthetic local-plane geometry, not real survey data.
The fixture defines the polygon boundary unambiguously.
The tested point is not on a boundary edge.

dynamic_data_handling.note: Geometry is frozen with the fixture; no external basemap or parcel service is queried.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative geometry result; not a real spatial analysis.

tasks.title: Line and polygon intersection
tasks.description: Test whether a synthetic path intersects a synthetic conservation zone and verify the boolean relation.
tasks.user_prompt: Check whether the synthetic survey path crosses the Cedar Green conservation zone. Return the relation and boolean result.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Evaluate the synthetic line-polygon intersection relation.

assumptions: The line and polygon are synthetic local-plane geometries.
Touching only at an endpoint is not part of this fixture case.
No real conservation boundary is represented.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The synthetic geometry is frozen; no external map layer is fetched.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative spatial relation; not a verified real-world intersection.

tasks.title: Within-distance relation for a synthetic point
tasks.description: Test whether a synthetic point is within 200 metres of a synthetic zone and verify the measured distance and threshold.
tasks.user_prompt: Check whether the synthetic point is within 200 metres of the Cedar Green zone. Report the boolean result and measured distance.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Evaluate the synthetic within-distance relation and return the fabricated distance.

assumptions: The point-to-zone distance is a fabricated fixture value, not a geodesic computation.
The threshold is in the same local metre unit as the fixture.
The zone geometry is synthetic and not a legal boundary.

dynamic_data_handling.note: Distance and threshold are frozen together; no live geometry service is used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative distance relation; not a real proximity finding.

tasks.title: Geocode a library then test its synthetic zone
tasks.description: Run a two-step chain: geocode Cedar Library, use its synthetic local coordinates as the subject, and test whether it lies in Cedar Green.
tasks.user_prompt: Geocode Cedar Library and test whether its synthetic local location lies within the Cedar Green zone. Report the boolean result and zone ID.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Resolve the synthetic library and its local-plane fixture coordinates.
Use the geocoded local point as the subject of the synthetic zone test.

assumptions: The geocoded record includes invented local-plane coordinates specifically for this synthetic chain.
The library location is not a real survey point.
The zone fixture is frozen and unambiguous.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The place record and zone relation are a single pinned fixture scenario.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative geocode-plus-spatial chain; not a live result.

tasks.title: Measure distance on a synthetic local plane
tasks.description: Measure the planar distance between two synthetic points and verify the value and metre unit.
tasks.user_prompt: Measure the distance between the synthetic points (0, 0) and (300, 400) on the local metre plane. Return the value and unit.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Measure the synthetic planar distance between two points.

assumptions: Coordinates are local-plane metres, not longitude and latitude.
Planar Euclidean distance is the intended synthetic measurement.
The value is an illustrative fixture, not a survey result.

dynamic_data_handling.note: Geometry and expected value are frozen together; no live projection service is used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative geometric measurement; not a real-world survey.

tasks.title: Measure the area of a synthetic polygon
tasks.description: Measure a synthetic 100-by-50 metre rectangle and verify the square-metre result.
tasks.user_prompt: Measure the area of the synthetic rectangle with vertices (0,0), (100,0), (100,50), and (0,50). Return the value and unit.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Measure the area of the synthetic rectangle.

assumptions: The polygon is a simple, non-self-intersecting synthetic rectangle.
Coordinates are local-plane metres.
No real parcel or land-cover boundary is represented.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The polygon and expected area are frozen fixture data.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative area fixture; not a cadastral measurement.

tasks.title: Measure bearing and midpoint on a synthetic plane
tasks.description: Measure the synthetic bearing and midpoint from (0,0) to (100,100) and verify both returned components.
tasks.user_prompt: For the synthetic local-plane segment from (0,0) to (100,100), report the bearing in degrees and the midpoint.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Measure the synthetic bearing and midpoint of one segment.

assumptions: Bearing is measured clockwise from local north on a synthetic plane.
The segment is diagonal with equal east and north components.
The values are illustrative and not a navigation-grade measurement.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The synthetic segment is fixed; no magnetic declination or live navigation data is used.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative bearing and midpoint fixture; not a field observation.

tasks.title: Measure a synthetic polyline in three steps
tasks.description: Measure two synthetic segment lengths and the total polyline length in a three-call chain, verifying each recorded value.
tasks.user_prompt: Measure the synthetic polyline through (0,0), (300,400), and (300,900). Report both segment lengths and the total length.

reference_tool_chain.purpose: Measure the first synthetic segment.
Measure the second synthetic segment.
Measure the total synthetic polyline length.

assumptions: All coordinates are local-plane metres.
The polyline is traversed in the listed order.
The total is the sum of the two synthetic segments.

dynamic_data_handling.note: The full polyline and all expected values are one frozen fixture scenario.

source.note: Synthetic/illustrative polyline measurement; not a real route survey.
